query: How to recover SQLite WAL after SQLITE_BUSY

claim_store.content: For SQLite WAL reservations using stock and request_id, recover SQLITE_BUSY at BEGIN IMMEDIATE by waiting within the busy_timeout budget; retry BEGIN after the competing writer commits.
For SQLite WAL reservations using stock and request_id, recover SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT at UPDATE by rolling back the read transaction; retry BEGIN and re-read stock after the competing writer commits.
